- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Brooklyn Museum's collection includes over 500,000 works of art, spanning 5,000 years of human creativity.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Brooklyn Museum has works by women artists, including Frida Kahlo, Mary Cassatt, and Georgia O'Keeffe.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The museum presents thematic exhibitions that explore feminist themes, such as gender, identity, power, and social justice.
